newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 1,008,900 MT were one-third below the week earlier, but 9 percent over the 4-week average.

The primary buyers were Taiwan (328,100 MT), Spain (203,400 MT, includes 121,400 new sales, 82,000 destination changes), Japan (202,900 MT, includes 227,700 new sales, 45,500 destination changes, 70,300 cancellations), Egypt (193,900 MT, includes 76,100 new sales, 117,800 destination changes), and Portugal (60,000 MT).
Decreases of 112,700 MT were reported for unknown destinations.

Exports of 958,700 MT were 5 percent lower than the previous week and 2 percent less than the 4-week average. The principal destinations were Japan (213,600 MT), South Korea (157,000 MT), Egypt (152,500 MT), Taiwan (76,000 MT), Portugal (65,000 MT), and Spain (61,400 MT).
